name: IEC 62196 Type 1 (SAE J1772)
description: Single-phase AC charging interface: configuration Type 1 of IEC 62196-2, the coupler of SAE J1772 used in North America. Five contacts: two power contacts (L1 and L2/N), protective earth, control pilot (CP) and connection switch (CS, the proximity contact). The vehicle connector is always attached to the charging cable; there is no Type 1 socket-outlet.

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase
conditions: Rating of the Type 1 vehicle connector in IEC 62196-2:2025: 250 V maximum, up to 32 A single-phase (table 201, standard sheet 2-I).
IEC 62196-2 table 201 assigns the second power contact as L2 (line 2) or N (neutral), depending on the supply; it is therefore not mapped to a single function here.
CP and CS are signal contacts rated 30 V, 2 A.
In the US, branch-circuit overcurrent protection is based on 125 % of the rated current of the device (table 201, footnote).

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase, up to 80 A (US, KR, JP)
conditions: IEC 62196-2:2025, 9.201, NOTE: in the US, KR and JP, standard sheets 2-I and 2-Ia may apply to vehicle connectors with a rated current up to 80 A.
The second power contact is L2 or N depending on the supply (table 201).
Products are rated individually; for example one vehicle inlet datasheet gives 80 A / 250 V AC.

notes: Ratings come from the French-language IEC 62196-2:2025 preview sample; the SAE J1772 text (AC Level 1/Level 2 ratings) was not reviewed, only its abstract.
The vehicle connector contact gender is inferred from its mating with the male inlet; its face is not drawn because no reviewed source depicts it.
Proximity (CS) coding is not recorded: the inlet datasheet gives 2.7 kΩ between PE and CS for that product, but the normative SAE J1772 / IEC 61851-1 circuit was not reviewed.
No split-phase (US 240 V, L1–L2) profile is recorded: no reviewed source gives split-phase ratings.
